correctness.rationale: The candidate lemma derives all minimal absent words from empty/positive adjacent suffix-LCP cores by the exact simultaneous left/right extension test. Prefix-doubling suffix sorting and Kasai LCP are exact integer/string procedures; all ten finite m=7..16 were exhaustively run and checked against complete output digests and the stated length spectrum, and a distinct direct all-factor exhaustive enumerator agrees at m=7,8 and on 128 deterministic short random inputs. Decimation recursion independently regenerates input prefixes. Code is included, along with table and boundaries. No infinite-m theorem is claimed.

value.rationale: Exact finite antidictionary length spectra of ten natural and increasingly long prefixes of a classical 2-automatic sequence are meaningful concrete structural benchmarks. Each dyadic doubling adds precisely eight MAWs within the proved interval, while only one longest obstruction survives. The complete length distribution, rather than a single small-case total, isolates boundary-sensitive missing contexts relevant to substring indexing, antidictionary compression, and conjectures about infinite sequence families. No extrapolation beyond level 16 is claimed.
